faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to a few common questions

items.q: What kind of opportunities are you looking for?
items.a: I'm open to AI Engineer and Machine Learning Engineer roles, focused on video generation, image generation, and multimodal systems. Full-time positions or high-impact contract work are both welcome.

items.q: What does your tech stack look like?
items.a: On the AI side: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, diffusion and multimodal models. On the engineering side: TypeScript, Next.js, and React — full-stack delivery from prototype to deployment.

items.q: Are you available for freelance or collaborations?
items.a: Yes — especially AI short-film production and technical collaborations. Feel free to reach out through the form below or any of the channels listed.

items.q: Where can I see more of your work?
items.a: Check the Projects and Creative sections above, browse the blog for technical write-ups, or visit my GitHub for source code.
